name: Xpdf
listed_description: Xpdf is a free PDF viewer and toolkit, including a text extractor, image converter, HTML converter, and more.
reason: xpdfreader.com unreachable from this environment (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) and no repo on github.com. WebSearch found no benchmark where Xpdf beats poppler or PDFium. Only numbers found are PyMuPDF's vendor appendix (documentation.help/PyMuPDF/app1.html) showing MuPDF 2.3-2.6x faster than xpdf for text extraction and about 3x faster rendering, i.e. Xpdf is the slower baseline. The invoice2data and justin-aj/pdf-extraction-benchmark pages do not test Xpdf. No numeric claim of Xpdf being faster found.

name: Yocto/GL
listed_description: Tiny C++ Libraries for Data-Driven Physically-based Graphics
reason: Opened repo page, readme.md and docs/index.md: MIT, 2.9k stars, no benchmark, speed claim or numbers against any baseline. Issues search shows only two closed titles with 'faster' (#763 faster hashing for edges and obj, #81 faster object reference during serialization), no bodies or numbers. WebSearch found no third-party comparison. Only performance-related note: optional Embree backend for ray casting via YOCTO_EMBREE, which is an integration not a comparison.
